sn42.10:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn42.10:1.2: tena kho pana samayena rājantepure rājaparisāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi:
sn42.10:1.3: “kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ, sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, patigaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajata”nti.
sn42.10:2.1: tena kho pana samayena maṇicūlako gāmaṇi tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
sn42.10:2.2: atha kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi taṃ parisaṃ etadavoca:
sn42.10:2.4: na kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ, na sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, na patigaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatāti.
sn42.10:2.5: asakkhi kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ.
sn42.10:2.6: atha kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn42.10:2.7: idha bhante rājantepure rājaparisāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarā kathā udapādi:
sn42.10:2.8: kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ, sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, patigaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajatanti.
sn42.10:2.9: evaṃ vuttāhaṃ bhante taṃ parisaṃ etadavoca:
sn42.10:2.11: na kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ, na sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, napatigaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatāti.
sn42.10:2.12: asakkhiṃ khohaṃ taṃ bhante parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ.
sn42.10:2.13: kaccāhaṃ bhante evaṃ vyākaramāno vuttavādī ceva bhagavato homi, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāmi, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaromi, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatīti.
sn42.10:3.1: taggha tvaṃ gāmaṇi evaṃ vyākaramāno vuttavādī ceva me hosi, na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhasi, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākarosi, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati.
sn42.10:3.2: na hi kappati gāmaṇi samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ, na sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, na patigaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sākyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatā.
sn42.10:3.3: yassa kho gāmaṇi jātarūparajataṃ kappati, pañcapi tassa kāmaguṇā kappanti.
sn42.10:3.4: yassa pañcakāmaguṇā kappanti, ekaṃsenetaṃ gāmaṇi dhāreyyāsi: assamaṇadhammo asakkiyaputtiyadhammoti.
sn42.10:3.6: tiṇaṃ tiṇatthikena pariyesitabbaṃ, dāruṃ dārutthikena pariyesitabbaṃ, sakaṭaṃ sakaṭatthikena pariyesitabbaṃ, puriso purisatthikena pariyesitabbo.
sn42.10:3.7: natvevāhaṃ gāmaṇi kenaci pariyāyena jātarūparajataṃ sāditabbaṃ pariyesitabbanti vadāmīti.
